checkpoints.claim_or_design_tested: The canonical Cloudflare research runner remains mandatory because package.json currently invokes it from test:local-gate and test:pages-preview.
checkpoints.challenge_method: Compared the runner's executable assertions with the package scripts and constructed a counterfactual package edit that removes the Cloudflare step from a canonical gate while preserving the test:cloudflare-research alias.

remaining_uncertainty: Other publication or deployment entrypoints may exist outside the two currently designated package gates.
